dublinCore.dc:title: 118 HR 10144 IH: Housing Access Improvement Act
dublinCore.dc:rights: Pursuant to Title 17 Section 105 of the United States Code, this file is not subject to copyright protection and is in the public domain.

action.action-desc: Mr. Panetta (for himself, Mr. Schiff, Ms. Lofgren, Mr. Lieu, and Mr. Gomez) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Financial Services

form.official-title: To increase the percentage of authorized units that a public housing agency may use for PHA project-based assistance, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Housing Access Improvement Act.

subsection.text: Section 8(o)(13)(B) of the United States Housing Act of 1937 (42 U.S.C. 1437f(o)(13)(B)) is amended—

paragraph.text: in clause (i), by striking 20 percent and inserting 30 percent; and

subparagraph.text: by striking A public housing agency may and inserting the following:

subclause.header: With respect to homeless persons and families

subparagraph.text: by adding at the end the following:

subclause.text: Notwithstanding clause (i) and subclause (II), the Secretary may, at the request of a public housing agency, allow such public housing agency to use additional units for project-based assistance under this paragraph.

subsection.text: The Secretary of Housing and Urban Development shall, not later than 90 days after the date on which the amendments made by subsection (a) take effect, issue such rules and guidance as the Secretary determines necessary to carry out section 8(o)(13)(B)(ii)(II) of the United States Housing Act of 1937, as added by subsection (a).
The amendments made by subsection (a) shall take effect beginning in the first fiscal year that begins after the date of the enactment of this Act.
